data.title: Heitman Appoints John Lee to Lead Sales in Korea
data.description: Heitman, a worldwide real estate investment management company, has revealed the hiring of John Lee as the new Head of Sales in Korea within its Client Service & Marketing group. Situated in Seoul, John's responsibilities will include overseeing capital raising and maintaining investor relations for the firm's real estate private equity and debt platforms. This move aims to enhance Heitman's influence in Korea. John will be reporting directly to John Mancuso, Managing Director and Head of Global Sales.Character count: 88

data.title: CitroTech Reports Growing Commercial Adoption as Industry Shifts Away from Phosphate-Based Fire Retardants
data.description: In Greenwood Village, Colorado, CitroTech Inc. (NYSE AM: CITR), a specialized chemical firm crafting eco-friendly fire-inhibition products, is witnessing a rapid uptake of its EPA Safer Choice-approved wildfire prevention technology. This trend comes as clients and collaborators shift from phosphate-centered fire retardants. Wes Bolsen, CEO of CitroTech, stated that the current momentum is just the start of a growing trajectory for the company.

data.title: Post Oak Energy Capital Announces Ichthys Energy Partners Asset Monetization
data.description: Post Oak Energy Capital, LP announced that Ichthys Energy Partners, LLC has successfully sold a portion of its Permian Basin assets to several buyers. Ichthys, headquartered in Dallas, focuses on inventory aggregation and development in the Northern Delaware Basin. Post Oak extended an equity commitment to Ichthys in October 2024. This sale signifies a milestone in Ichthys' strategy, demonstrating Post Oak's consistent success in supporting energy ventures.

data.title: Neighborhood Intelligence and Alliant Credit Union Announce Strategic Partnership to Launch Beyond Credit Union
data.description: Neighborhood Intelligence (NASDAQ: NXH) and Alliant Credit Union have initiated a strategic alliance in Nashville, introducing Beyond Credit Union, powered by Alliant. This platform aims to simplify and reduce costs in the homeownership process. Beyond Credit Union, being part of Neighborhood Intelligence’s Everything Home ecosystem, will provide financial services, educational resources, and tools to facilitate the journey towards homeownership.

data.title: Olá! e.l.f. Cosmetics Launches in Brazil Exclusively with Sephora
data.description: e.l.f. Cosmetics, a brand under e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), has revealed its entry into the Brazilian market through a partnership with Sephora. This move marks e.l.f. Cosmetics as the initial mass color brand available at Sephora in Brazil. The brand is known for its blend of premium-quality items, cutting-edge innovation, and affordability. e.l.f. Beauty has been actively expanding its brands globally and has managed to double international sales penetration. This expansion is a significant step for e.l.f. Cosmetics as it aims to reach a wider audience in Brazil through this exclusive collaboration with Sephora.

data.title: Coforge Expands Automotive Engineering Footprint to Accelerate Connected, EV and Software-Defined Vehicle Innovation
data.description: Coforge, based in Princeton, New Jersey, has announced its expansion of automotive engineering services in Greater Noida, India. This move aims to drive advancements in connected vehicles, electric vehicles, and software-defined vehicles. The company is looking to accelerate innovation in these areas by leveraging its expertise in automotive engineering.

data.title: Empery Digital Sends Letter to Shareholders Detailing Efforts to Maximize Long-Term Value Creation for Shareholders
data.description: In Austin, Texas, Empery Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: EMPD) has announced the upcoming 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders which is set to occur on October 14, 2026. Shareholders who held shares as of September 2, 2026, will be able to vote at the meeting. Empery Digital sent a letter to shareholders discussing the bright future for the company and its shareholders.

data.title: StackGen Launches the Autonomous Operations Factory
data.description: In San Francisco, StackGen has announced the launch of the Autonomous Operations Factory. This innovative system utilizes Aiden agents to manage infrastructure, delivery, SRE, and observability within a unified governed world model. This advancement marks a significant step forward in streamlining operations, with the potential to revolutionize the way businesses handle key processes.

data.title: TP-Link Announces Tapo Doorbell Pro D260, 4K Video Doorbell for Superior Entryway Security
data.description: TP-Link Systems Inc., headquartered in Irvine, California, has unveiled a new addition to its Tapo smart home line, the Tapo Doorbell Pro. The initial release features the Tapo D260 4K video doorbell, offering 4K video resolution, a wide field of view, radar-based motion detection, subscription-free AI, and adaptable installation choices. This innovation aims to provide exceptional clarity and intelligence for users.

data.title: Asahi Kasei Introduces VANTIJ® SU-VFC Benchtop to Improve Efficiency and Consistency in Gene Therapy Manufacturing
data.description: In Glenview, Illinois, Asahi Kasei Bioprocess is set to introduce the VANTIJ® SU-VFC Benchtop at the Bioprocess International East (BPI EAST) event in 2026.

data.title: Everbridge Unveils Everbridge 360 AI Protective Intelligence, Expanding AI-Powered Risk Intelligence
data.description: In Vienna, Virginia, Everbridge, a top provider of High Velocity Critical Event Management (CEM) solutions, unveiled notable advancements in its risk intelligence collection after launching Everbridge 360 AI at GSX 2026. The latest additions include Everbridge 360 AI Protective Intelligence and Everbridge 360 AI Risk Stream, amplifying organizations' capacities to detect emerging threats promptly and comprehend developing scenarios more accurately. These innovations strengthen responses by leveraging Artificial Intelligence for enhanced risk assessment.

data.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Falls As Yields, Oil Prices Rise Ahead Of Fed Meeting; Nvidia Set To Rebound (Live Coverage)
data.description: Today, the Dow Jones index experienced a decrease as the 10-year Treasury yield surged to its highest level recorded since 2007. On a positive note, Nvidia's stock witnessed an increase. The market saw a decline in the Dow Jones while the yields and oil prices rose, in anticipation of the upcoming Fed meeting. Nvidia is expected to make a strong recovery.
